enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poison Blast 6: This weapon drips with vile poison, dealing 6d6 Poison damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Poison damage on a critical hit.

Utter Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.
Fortitude Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.

Legendary Virulent Poison: This item carries a potent poison that is delivered with your attacks. On any strike, the Poison has a chance to be applied, dealing 5d6 Constitution damage if your enemy fails a DC100 Fortitude saving throw.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
